businessContext: Gamify, a commercial K-12 educational game platform from the Vermont Literacy Network. Teachers turn their own question sets into classroom games (live with a code or link, or as homework). Free tier plus teacher and school subscriptions; the goal is paid subscriptions. House rules: the owner approves every post, purchase and launch; student pages carry no ads, trackers or prices; English only; every asset needs a commercial license; every game passes the Golden Rule and the three lenses (K-3 student, K-12 gamer, teacher).
operatingRhythm: Owner checks the developer dashboard; the development plan doc is the build bible.
